description.value:
Signature Trait. The Goliar dominate a space by sheer mass. Three linked parts, always on:

  1. Large Size - you are size Large: longer reach, you can wield oversized gear, and you can grab, shove, or bull through smaller creatures with ease.
  2. Crushing Might - you gain an edge on tests to break, lift, haul, or force, and when you force-move a creature or object you push it noticeably farther.
  3. Intimidating Bulk - you gain an edge on tests to intimidate or frighten, turning your low Presence into fear-based social power rather than charm.

Big, strong, and scary - the iconic always-on package.
